name: Kubera
shortDescription: Household balance sheet. Essentials is $250 per year, with a 14-day trial.
longDescription: Kubera tracks a household balance sheet for a flat annual fee. On October 16, 2026 the wealth-tracker page listed Essentials at $250 per year and Black at $2,500 per year, with a 14-day trial and no fee based on assets. This is not financial advice.
pricingNotes: Essentials is $250 per year. Black is $2,500 per year. 14-day trial. No monthly price was listed. Not financial advice.
bestFor: Tracking a household balance sheet for a flat annual fee
notIdealFor: Someone who wants a lasting $0 plan
Anyone treating this card as financial advice
strength: Kubera Essentials is a flat $250 per year for one household, with a 14-day trial and no asset-based fee.
weakness: There is no lasting $0 plan, and the pages do not place trades for you.
